a.xlink:title: Contract for translating one or more protocol messages into model mutations.
Abstract base for protocol handlers; factors the shared parsing helpers.
Handles egg-specific messages: laying (enw) and connection/hatch (ebo).
Handles attributes common to any entity: position (ppo) and removal (pdi, edi).
Handles global/server messages: sgt, sst, seg, smg, suc, sbp and broadcast (pbc).
Handles incantation messages: start (pic) and end (pie).
Handles map-related messages: size (msz), tile content (bct), full map (mct).
Handles Trantorian-specific messages: pnw, plv, pin, pex, pfk, pdr, pgt, pipi.
